title: Rabbi Chanina ben Uri
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Derekh Eretz Rabbah, beginning of chapter 1: “This is an exposition that Rabbi Chanina ben Uri expounded before the sages in the name of Rabbi Natan.” Hyman infers from this that he was a Tanna.

notes.text: The named passage is directly present in the digital text titled Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 1:4: Chanina ben Uri expounds before the sages in Rabbi Natan’s name. The classification as a Tanna remains Hyman’s inference.
